title: OpenCode Plugin Lab configuration
description: Declares which OpenCode V2 plugins the lab stages, builds and tests, and which configurations it runs them in. One manifest fully describes a lab run.

version.description: Manifest schema version. Only 1 is defined.

opencode.description: Pinned runtime versions. Keep a tested version here; select another with LAB/OPENCODE_VERSION at build time.

defaultConfig.description: Configuration used by `make start` and as the default for `make test`. Defaults to the first entry in `configs`.

plugins.description: Every plugin the lab can build and test.

configs.description: Runtime configurations. Each one boots a real OpenCode server with a subset of the declared plugins.

globalSuites.description: Optional configuration-independent test extensions specific to this manifest (loaded once per run). Each module exports `run({ tier })`.

name.description: Stable lab identifier. Also the directory name under /opt/lab/plugins.

package.description: Upstream npm package name (informational; used in reports).

id.description: Expected runtime plugin id (e.g. lab.example). Optional; when omitted the plugin is matched by source path only.

options.description: Options passed to this plugin in every generated opencode config.

expectTools.description: Tool ids this plugin is expected to register. Empty means 'registers no tools' and tool assertions are skipped.

setupMarker.description: Optional string the plugin logs during setup. When present, the lab asserts it appears in the server log after boot.

cleanupMarker.description: Optional string the plugin logs on unload. When present, the lab asserts it appears in the server log after graceful shutdown.

expectedWrites.description: Top-level entries this plugin is expected to create inside a project (e.g. .plugin-state). Used by the generic write-boundary check.

tests.description: Optional plugin-specific test-extension modules, resolved relative to this manifest. Each module exports `run({ plugin, tier })`.

type.description: directory: a local source tree (staged + built). tarball: a local .tgz (unpacked, optionally built). package: an already-built package directory (used as-is). npm: an npm reference; never fetched unless allowRemote is true.

path.description: Directory or tarball path (for directory/tarball/package). Relative paths resolve against the manifest directory. Supports ~ and ${ENV_VAR} / ${ENV_VAR:-default}.

ref.description: npm reference such as name@1.2.3 (for npm). Required for type npm.

allowRemote.description: Explicit opt-in required before a `npm` source is fetched from the network.

commit.description: Optional commit the source corresponds to. Recorded as provenance when the source is not a git worktree (e.g. an exported tree or a tarball).

command.description: Build command run in the staged tree. Defaults to the package's own `build` script, or is skipped when the package has none and a dist is already present / entry is at the root.

install.description: Dependency-install command. Defaults to `npm ci` when a lockfile is present, else `npm install`.

dist.description: Directory of compiled output produced by the build. Defaults to 'dist'.

entry.description: Entry file inside `dist` that exports the plugin default. Defaults to 'index.js'.

rootEntry.description: When true the plugin entry lives at the package root (no dist/ shim is generated).

capabilities.description: What the plugin is expected to do. The harness only asserts applicable capabilities and reports the rest as skipped/unsupported.

redaction.description: Transforms model requests (secret redaction) on the supported request path.

network.description: Makes outbound network calls. Such plugins are only supported in the gated online tier.

scripts.description: Allow npm lifecycle scripts (preinstall/install/postinstall) during dependency installation. Default false (--ignore-scripts).

plugins.description: Plugin names (from `plugins`) loaded in this configuration, in load order.

template.description: Optional JSONC template for the base opencode config, resolved relative to the manifest. The plugin list is still generated from `plugins`.

options.description: Per-plugin option overrides keyed by plugin name.

settings.description: Extra top-level opencode config keys (e.g. compaction, providers), merged into the generated config.

module.description: Module path relative to this manifest. Exports `run({ tier })`.
